# Date picker dependencies

Vendored distributions for the methodology date picker (no build step).

- CalendarJS Community Edition 1.1.0: https://github.com/componade/calendarjs (MIT).
- LemonadeJS 5.3.6: https://github.com/lemonadejs/lemonadejs (MIT).

Files were retrieved from the matching npm package tarballs. CalendarJS license
was retrieved from its upstream repository; LemonadeJS license ships in npm.
Theme overrides are scoped to `.day-calendar` in `../styles.css`.
